label: Stripe
description: Accept payments and manage customers, subscriptions, refunds, and invoices in Stripe.
notes: Stripe's API is form-encoded, so bodies use urlencode templating throughout (no JSON-body typing issues). Simplifications: createCustomer drops the optional address block (empty address[country] etc. risk validation errors); description/phone are kept because Stripe accepts empty strings for free-text fields. createPaymentIntent takes amount in the smallest currency unit directly (AP multiplied a decimal by 100) and drops optional customer/payment_method/confirm/return_url/receipt_email — empty strings there are rejected or require conditional inclusion. createRefund is full-refund only (optional amount/reason cannot be conditionally included; empty values are rejected). createSubscription supports a single price item (AP supported an item array) and drops collection_method/trial/metadata. cancelSubscription cancels immediately via DELETE; AP's cancel-at-period-end variant needs a conditional branch between two different requests. searchCustomers sends the search query as a proper query param (AP source put it in a GET body). AP's find-invoice and retrieve-invoice hit the identical endpoint — deduped into one getInvoice node. Transpilable but omitted due to the 8-action cap: create-product, create-price, create-invoice, retrieve-payment-intent, retrieve-payout, deactivate-payment-link. update-customer omitted: every field is optional and Stripe rejects empty-string email/address values, so a fixed template cannot express a partial update. Live-catalog stripe nodes (listCharges, createPaymentLink, listCustomers, getBalance) have no id collisions with this batch; AP's create-payment-link was skipped as needsPieceRuntime and the live node already covers the simple case.
